balls.text: comes round the wicket and bowls a full toss and he makes room and tamely chips it to the onside but the ball dips in front of midwicket
fullish outside off and squeezes to the off side
he bashes that one-handed! He makes room and Pathan bowls it wide and Carseldine takes his left hand off the bat and slams it wide of backward point
full on middle and leg and he clips it down the ground to long-on
he chips down the track and takes it on the half volley and times the loft well but doesn't get the required distance to clear long-off and Jayawardene makes no mistake
full outside off and crashed down the ground to long-off
he drops it short and that too doesn't work for Sreesanth as the batsman swings and gets a thick top edge which clears the keeper by miles, and finally we have the first 200 of the tournament
full on the pads and clipped to deep midwicket
comes over the wicket and he makes room and forces it to long-off
Sreesanth bowls the slow legcutter again and Jadeja's picking it alright, he makes room and hoicks him down to deep midwicket
full outside off and he works it to sweeper cover
Free Hit jadeje gets on his knee and scoops him high over wide long-on, nightmare over for Sreesanth
Free Hit And he oversteps again! He bowls the legcutter and luckily it costs just a single as the batsman forces it to long-off
full outside off and he drives hard down to extra cover, it's an overstep
digs out a yorker and Jadeja sets off for a quick single, Irfan turns around and has a shy at the bowler's end and the ball deflects off Carseldine
makes room to a full ball and drills it very hard wide of cover
makes room and slashes hard and luckily the outside edge beats the keeper
makes room and Pathan drops it a bit too short, Jadeja gets on top of the bounce and slices it over the vacant slips region
drops it to the offside for a single
lovely shot to get off the mark, he gets his front foot forward and crashes a half volley through the big window at the covers
Ojha goes for the savage slog and perishes, he gets on his knee and the top edge swirls to Katich who runs forward from deep midwicket
just takes a few paces down the track and takes him downtown, he gets enough elevation to clear deep midwicket
Goel muffs it this time! Jadeja stays at the crease and scoops it straight to Goel at long-off but he's well in front of the rope, he falls backwards in vain in attempting a one-handed blinder
Chawla cuts back on the pace and gives it more air, Pathan stays at the crease and tries to hoick him over long-on but fails to get the distance and Goel cups it over his head
swings hard but too early and the ball rolls off his body
going, going....! He gets to the pitch of a half volley and lofts him several miles over long-off, Ojha tries to match Pathan stroke for stroke and he succeeds this time
fires it wide outside off and he fails to dig it out
pushed to sweeper cover
too full outside off and that's a suicidal length to bowl to Pathan as he reaches out and slices it high over backward point
slices it with one hand straight to point
looked like a mis-hit but boy was I proved wrong! He seizes on a short ball and clubs him high over deep square leg, that went rows back
steps down the track and he takes the ball on a yorker length and squirts it wide of square leg
relief for Punjab! Smith chips down the pitch and takes it on the full, he tries to clear long-on and Chawla makes no mistake at the boundary edge
flighted on middle and leg and he gets on his knee and pounds him wide of midwicket
chips down the pitch to slog and the inside edge nearly rolls onto the stumps
fires a low full toss and Ojha ends up jamming it onto his pads
flighted on middle and leg and he clips it with the line to fine leg
makes a bit of room and plays a powerful offdrive wide of long-off
exposes his stumps and Sreesanth fires a yorker length ball and Ojha jams it out hard to sweeper cover
drops it short on seeing him make room and he fails to make contact with the upper cut
gets beside the line and steers it to the off side
it's a low full toss and Smith will play them in his sleep, he shuffles and times the clip well past midwicket, he bisects the gap well at the deep
starts off with a yorker and Ojha jams it out to cover point
tosses it on middle and leg and he gets to the pitch of the ball and drives to long-off
clips it with the turn to long-on
picks the googly just in time as he adjusts and punches it back to the bowler
tries to sweep fine but he finds short fine leg
gets forward and drives against the turn to the off side
Smith gets on his knee early and connects really well with the sweep, he picks the big gap at deep square-leg
full on middle and leg and he pushes it down the ground to long-on
pushed to the onside
strays down the legside and he shuffles a bit and clips it to fine leg
the leading edge falls in front of point and that's Ojha's maiden IPL fifty, he's been entertaining this afternoon
Ojha just waited patiently for the ball to come onto him before deliberately dabbing it wide of the keeper and short third man made a good attempt at pulling it back
lands it on middle and off and he makes room and cuts to deep cover
comes down the pitch and drives inside out to long-off
steps down the track a little too far and he fails to get underneath the bounce and hence he gets a thick edge onto his boot
flighted on middle and leg and he pushes it to long-on
kneels down and sweeps hard straight to deep square-leg
he tosses it up ever so slowly outside off and that gives him time to step down the track and hoick it over midwicket
spins away from him and the bat is nowhere near the ball when he slogs
the umpires have goofed up the number of balls, the extra ball doesn't cost anything as he drops it short and Ojha fails to upper cut it over the keeper
very well played indeed! Ojha stays at the crease and waits for it to come onto him before dabbing it wide of the keeper, Sreesanth dives in vain at third man
drops it short and he steers it hard down to point
full outside the offstump and he gets forward and drives to mid-off
chips down the track and he picks the slower ball early and forces it well wide of mid-off, Abdulla is struggling a bit today
full in length and he pushes it hard to mid-off
wham! Smith makes a lot of room and an attempted yorker turns into a friendly full toss and Smith carves it over point
comes down the pitch and drives to mid-on
opens the face of the bat and dabs it straight to point
gets forward to the pitch of the ball and drives down the ground to long-on and a fumble allows another run
gets forward and pushes it down the pitch
sweeps squarer this time but Mahela is there to mop up
tosses it up on the legstump and Smith gets on his knee and sweeps hard and sweeps fine
it's given as runs so a chance missed by Sangakkara, Ojha sweeps too early and gets a bit of bat on ball and the edge beats Sanga and races to third man
makes room and pushes it down the ground to long-on
comes down the pitch and clips it wide of midwicket
chips down the track and he works it across the line to deep square-leg
reaches out and drives a full delivery down to deep cover
tossed up outside leg and he works it with the turn to the on side
tosses it up outside off, he makes room and deliberately dabs it wide of Abdulla at short third man
gives it a lot of air and lands it on a yorker length and Ojha digs it out
he doesn't pick the googly and gets a thick leading edge which drops well short of mid-off
gets on his knee, fetches it from outside off and sweeps
chips down and checks his shot and I think there was some bat involved before the ball lobbed off the pads
no turn, he gets forward and defends
he strays down the legside and he feeds Smith in his favourite area, he shuffles and clips it to the huge gap at fine leg
he pushes a half volley past the bowler and a diving effort by mid-off could have cut off the boundary, the fielders have been a little flat
he pushes it wide of mid-off and he's a little late in getting to the ball and hence fumbles
full in length again and he works it across the line and he finds square leg
full on middle and off and he works it across the line to deep midwicket, there's protection there
Abdulla starts off with a yorker outside off and Ojha jams it out to third man
drifts down the leg stump from round the wicket and Smith shuffles and clips it wide of fine leg, after a bit of hesitation he completes the second
Heads up! He errs by dropping it a bit too full and Smith enjoys a joyride down the track and scoops him straight and nearly cleans up the umpire
Smith walks across his stumps and pushes it back to the bowler, Sreesanth doesn't give him room
gives him a wee bit of room and Ojha frees his arms and glides it down to square third man
another good delivery, cramps him for room and Ojha settles for a steer to the off side
gets it to kick up off a good length and Ojha gets behind and defends
he makes room and gives it a mighty biff past backward point, he rolls his wrists and puts it away with force
takes the aerial route but luckily for the batsman he mistimes the loft and the ball dips well in front of mid-on
makes room and hops at the crease as he pushes it back to the bowler, that's a gully cricket shot
close shave! He exposes his stumps and swishes across the line and the ball misses the bat and nearly shaves the legstump
keeps it up and he taps it back to the bowler
excellent use of the bottom hand by Ojha! He picks a short delivery on the offstump and plays a savage pull over deep square-leg
and Jayawardene nearly pulls off a blinder! can't call that a drop, Smith forces it to Sreesanth's left and nearly chips it to the fielder, good fielding all the same
Smith walks right across his stumps to distract the bowler and he cramps himself for room in the process and mistimes the shot to mid-on
he tries to slam that down the pitch but he turns the face of the bat at the point of contact and hence mistimes it to mid-on
better delivery, lands it in the offstump at a good pace and Ojha hammers it down to mid-off
down the legside and the ball clips his thigh and dips to the keeper
Free Hit Good comeback by Sreesanth as he bowls a slow legcutter and Smith swings too early and tamely heaves it to the on side
awesome start to the tournament for Sreesanth, he oversteps, he can thank the batsman for shouldering arms
angles it into the right-hander and he closes the face of the bat and pushes it to mid-on
excellent inswinging yorker on the base of the offstump and Ojha watches it and digs it out
he slashes hard at a delivery which goes across him and that nearly takes the edge
in the slot to drive and he gets his bat down and punches hard but finds short extra cover
strays on the pads again and he works it away squarer on the on side
poor delivery and he strays down the legside, Smith who's in need of runs accepts the offering with glee and glances him down to fine leg
16 off the over! Powar isn't afraid to flight it and Ojha isn't afraid to chio down the track and slam him high over the sightscreen, what fun!
tosses it up outside off and he reaches out and scoops it over cover point, he;s enjoying himself
stifled appeal, the ball hits his pads outside the line of the leg stump
swings wildly and Powar cleverly tosses it up and cuts back on the pace, beats him completely
didn't take long for him to warm up! Powar tosses it up and Ojha dances down the track and deposits it high over long-on, super shot
tossed up on the pads and he works it down to the on side
safely defended off the backfoot and game over!
that's a cracker of a shot! But too late, he crashes a full delivery down the ground and long-off dives in vain
gets right behind and defends again
digs it in short and he watches it through to the keeper
batting practice, he gets across, right behind the line and defends to mid-off
squirts it to the offside for a single
full on the offstump and dug out to cover
full on the stumps and Singh appeals for a catch thinking he chipped it back to him on the full
bowls a full toss and he pushes it to to long-off
full on middle and leg and worked to the on side
goes for the woodchop off a short delivery and mis-hits it, he almost plays it one-handed the top edge swirls in the air to Harwood at square leg
shortish outside off and he taps it wide of backward point
strays wide down the leg side, umpire Sanjay Hazare has had quite a stretch this evening
bangs it in short and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
shuffles and clips it to the off side
digs it in short, too high for Yuvraj and another wide called
dabs it down to third man
fullish outside off and he jams it out hard to cover
short outside off and he reaches out and slaps it to third man
short on the legstump, he swats it behind square on the on side for a couple
punches it to the on side
he goes high again, straight over the bowler's head and Carseldine runs backwards and tries to pull off a one-handed stunner
the arm ball, down the leg side, he pulls early and doesn't make proper contact
makes room and squirts it to the off side
he goes big, he goes maximum again! He gets on his knee and slogs him high over deep midwicket, at this rate he will dent that roof
drops it short and he picks the length early and whams it past the covers
flighted on middle and off and Chawla goes for broke by dancing down the track, he skies it miles up in the air and Jadeja runs across from long-on and catches it
he loves tonking them around at Kingsmead doesn't he? He gets on his knee and slogs him to the roof at deep midwicket
rocks back and slaps it hard to sweeper cover
lands the googly wide outside off and he doesn't offer a shot
shuffles and knocks it away wide of square leg for a single
slower ball and he steers it down to point
the slower delivery hits him flush on the base of the pads but outside the line of leg, Amit appeals
really shoots up on him and the batsman manages to fend it off with soft hands
full and wide outside off and he stays rooted to the crease and slashes
slower ball and he checks his pull and lofts it to fine leg
down the legside and he glances it to fine leg
comes down the track and lofts him down to long-on
he gets a lucky leading edge which beats the keeper and short third man, no slip in place
yet another wheel falls off for Punjab, Irfan gets on his knee to play an ambitious sweep, the ball lands outside off and drifts in slightly and clips his pad in front of the stumps
gives him a bit of width outside off and he stays at the crease and bashes it wide of the covers, he places it in the big gap
chips down the track and forces it to long-on
tries to squeeze it past point but he can't find the gap
chops it down to short third man
goes for a wild slog but the ball clips the edge and rolls away to the on side
drops it a fraction short and he swivels and thumps it hard over midwicket, Punjab are hitting back but is it too late?
punched to the off side
slams it to sweeper cover and Raut does really well to slide to his right and cut off a boundary
punches it back to the bowler
goes back and across and punches it to long-on
strays down the legside and wide called
gets well forward and defends
out of the ground! can we have the ball back please? Yuvraj gets on his knee and displays the cleanest of slogs over deep midwicket, the longest six of the match and they have to replace the ball
tosses it on off and he defends forward
punched hard right back to the bowler, good over for Punjab, the ball's finding the middle of the bat
makes room and slashes off the meat of the bat to sweeper cover
shuffles and nudges it to mid-on
and finally Yuvvraj wakes up, he seizes a slightly short delivery and thwacks it along the turf to deep mkidwicket
rocks back and clips it to the on side
Irfan wins round1! He steps down the track to  a pitched up delivery and slams him to the sight screen
gets behind the line and steers it to the off side
Yuvraj withdraws on seeing another bouncer and another wide called, another 159 bouncers and Punjab will win
the bouncer and Yuvraj cannot reach it, Harwood is penalised
jaffa! Hits the deck hard and gets some movement off the pitch and Yuvraj pokes at it and nearly gets a feather edge
swings and meets thin air, Harwood drops it short and the ball fizzes past Yuvraj
stays rooted to the crease and chops it in the air towards mid-off, another loose shot, nothing going right for Punjab
gives him a bit of width and he opens the face and steers it to third man
drops it short of a length outside off and he steers it straight to point
yorker length outside off and he jams it out to sweeper cover
taps it towards mid-off and takes a risky single and a direct hit by Carseldine would have sent Irfan packing
slower ball and he checks his drive and chips it in the air towards mid-on, no fielder out there
gets beside the line and taps it to the off side
drops it a bit short and Irfan stands on one leg and whiplashes him to deep square leg
fullish on middle and off and he pushes it to mid-off
taps it in front of point and sets off quickly and the throw at the bowlers' end is wide
wide outside off and he flays at it without moving his feet
too quick for everybody at Kingsmead, the bouncer shoots high over Pathan and the keeper who leaps up in vain

Harwood has his revenge after that six! He digs it in short and Jayawardene makes room the other way this time, the upper cut flies quick and flat to Trivedi who runs across at third man and takes the catch
shot! He swivels and gets across his stumps and scoops a fractionally short delivery over fine leg, that went rows back
bashed hard on the front foot and Warne intercepts it with his boot, that travelled like lightening
full outside off and he drives firmly but can't beat Warne at short cover, nice sliding save
flashes hard outside off and the ball clips the edge and drops to Ojha on the first bounce
he makes room to a slower delivery and mistimes the swat down to cover, a more packed off side field would have sent hm back
Trivedi bowls a jaffa outside the offstump, the ball kicks up a bit and swings away, Yuvraj nearly gets an edge
drifts on the pads and he whips it away to fine leg
slower ball and he flashes hard on the front foot and misses
stays right behind the line and defends a short delivery
drops it short and Jayawardene flashes hard and the bat was nowhere near the ball
Ojha's alert alright despite the blow! Yusuf fires one quick and short on seeing Sanga chip down the track, he swings and misses and Ojha breaks the bails
drops it short and he pulls to deep square leg

ouch! Sanga swings early and misses and the ball skids through and hits Ojha flush on the grill, I don't know if the ball actually struck him straight on the face but he's obviously in some pain, maybe the helmet wasn't fastened properly, whatever it is you will not want to be in Ojha's shoes right now
pulls to short fine leg
makes room and Yusuf follows him by firing it flat and fast on the legstump, he taps it to mid-on
opens the face of the bat and taps it down towards point

sound of leather on wood! Trivedi fires a yorker length delivery outside off and has Katich flashing hard without moving his feet, he gets a thick inside edge and looks back to see his offstump flattened
lands it outside off and he opts to shoulder arms this time
slides on middle and leg and Katich improvises by flicking it late and finding the big gap at fine leg
digs out a yorker towards short mid-off and sets off quickly and the under arm flick just misses the stumps at the bowler's end
much better, he walks down the pitch and ends up getting nicely to the pitch, a free swing of the bat allows him to club it over mid-on
tries to slog him over midwicket but he ends up swishing at thin air
bad delivery, short down the legside and he swivels and pulls him down to fine leg
he's struggling to push it off the square, he stays back and finds the fielder at mid-off
stays back and defends again
cramped for room, he stays back and defends
well stopped by Niraj Patel at square leg, he slides and stops it
floated down the legside and he nudges it to the on side
flicks it off his pads
Punjab will need about 30 more of those, he drops it short and Sanga swivels and pulls wide of fine leg
swings too early and the ball clips his body and trickles to the off side, Katich really scampers back to the crease t beat the throw
angles it on the pads again and he shuffles and clips it past short fine leg off his pads
full on the pads and he gets across and works it behind square on the on side
moves across his stumps and clips it softly towards fine leg
shuffles and clips it to the on side
Dropped And it's the captain! Sanga prods forward to an away swinging delivery and gets a thick outside edge and Warne gets on his knee and fluffs a sitter at second slip
shuffles and clips a full delivery close to his pads to deep square-leg
this one really kicks up Katich does well to drop his left hand out of the way to fend it off
gets behind the line and punches it to short cover
gets a bit of extra bounce and a tentative Katich cuts and misses it completely
Goel goes for broke and mis-hits it! He swings hard and tries to clear the rope at deep square leg, the ball soars miles up in the air and Harwood fixes his gaze and takes it calmly
angles it on the pads and he shuffles and clips it down to fine leg
swings it on the pads and he clips it behind square on the on side
he chips down the track and he bowls it full on the pads and Goel fails to make contact
lands it on the offstump and he defends to the offside
yet another golden duck in this tournament! Singh drops it short and wide and Sohal shapes to leave but completely misjudges the line, the ball clips the outside edge and Warne takes it at slip
